slides.title: Yelp's AI now books the table for you
slides.sub: Yelp's fall release puts an AI assistant between your customers and your door. Here's what it reads before it sends them to you.

slides.title: 30+ new features in one drop
slides.body: On October 20, Yelp announced its fall product release with more than 30 new features, updates and integrations, many built around Yelp Assistant.

slides.title: Booking happens in the chat
slides.body: Yelp Assistant can now book OpenTable restaurants on iOS and join a Yelp Waitlist. Yelp says it reaches more than half a million restaurants.

slides.title: Service pros are in it too
slides.body: Customers can request quotes for up to five projects in one conversation and book plumbers, electricians, HVAC pros and cleaners.

slides.title: An AI that answers your leads
slides.body: Smart Lead Reply answers Request a Quote leads, gathers project details and qualifies them. Yelp prices it at $30 a month, rolling out next month.

slides.title: It reads what you show it
slides.body: Yelp says Assistant draws on hundreds of millions of reviews, photos and business details. A thin page with weak photos gives it little to work with.

slides.title: Make the page Yelp's AI reads look like you.
slides.body: We build brand identities, visual systems and websites for Black-owned businesses, so every button Assistant shows leads somewhere strong. DM us YELP to talk it through.

caption:
Yelp AI Assistant checklist: 4 things Black-owned small businesses should fix on their Yelp page now that AI is doing the recommending.

On October 20, Yelp announced its fall product release with more than 30 new features, updates and integrations. Yelp Assistant can now book OpenTable restaurants on iOS, join a Yelp Waitlist, and request quotes for up to five projects in one conversation. Yelp says Assistant reaches more than half a million restaurants and draws on hundreds of millions of reviews, photos and business details. For service pros, Smart Lead Reply answers and qualifies Request a Quote leads for $30 a month, rolling out next month.

Here's what to tighten first:
1. A clear logo that reads as a tiny profile image.
2. Recent, well lit photos that show your real space and work.
3. Hours, services and prices that match everywhere you're listed.
4. A website that loads fast, because "visit website" is one of Assistant's buttons.

AI can only recommend what it can see. Give it something worth showing.
